protocol.name: virtual_keyboard_unstable_v1

description.summary: virtual keyboard protocol, as used by the test harness

protocol.description:
This describes zwp_virtual_keyboard_unstable_v1 well enough to generate a client for it. It is used by internal/testenv to give the headless compositor a keyboard: without one the test seat advertises no keyboard capability at all, and nothing about typing at a ghost — or about keyboard focus, which is where two real bugs have lived — can be exercised under test.
Written for this repository rather than copied from wlr-protocols, which is not available on an offline build machine, and deliberately minimal: only what the harness sends. If the upstream file is ever vendored here, prefer it, regenerate, and delete this note. The wire format is the same either way — a mismatch would be rejected by the compositor rather than silently mis-parsed, which is what makes writing this out safe.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1
interface.description:
A virtual keyboard device, whose key events are handled by the compositor as though they came from a physical keyboard on the seat.
The keymap must be sent before any key event, or the compositor raises a protocol error.

request.name: keymap
request.description: Provide a file descriptor to the compositor which can be memory-mapped to hold the keymap description. Format is one of the wl_keyboard keymap formats: 1 is xkb_v1.

request.name: key
request.description: A key was pressed or released. Keycodes are raw evdev codes, not offset by 8 as in the X11 convention, and state is one of the wl_keyboard key states: 0 released, 1 pressed.

request.name: modifiers
request.description: Notify the compositor that the modifier and/or group state has changed, in the same terms wl_keyboard uses.

description.summary: destroy the virtual keyboard keyboard object

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: A global interface for creating virtual keyboards on a seat.

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: client not authorized to use the interface

request.name: create_virtual_keyboard
request.description: Creates a new virtual keyboard associated with the seat.
